title: Millionaire Mindset
tagline: 15 questions. Three lifelines. ₦1,000,000 at the top.
description: Climb a 15-step prize ladder, use your lifelines wisely and decide whether to risk it or walk away. Questions are drawn at random from a bank of 269, from easy to very hard. No account, no download and no real money.
features: 50:50, Phone a friend and Ask the audience lifelines
Safe havens at question 5 and question 10
Walk away any time and keep your last secured prize
Optional AI-written questions with your own free Groq key
